purpose: On-page heading outline that renders nested anchor links and highlights the active section while scrolling.
useWhen: Adding an "On this page" rail for long-form docs or settings screens.
Letting users jump between headings while keeping context via active-section highlighting.

avoidWhen.reason: Navigating between routes or top-level app areas — use navigation-bar or side-navigation.
The page has too few headings to justify a secondary navigation rail.
Rendering expandable hierarchical data with selection state.
